o.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian موسیقی (mūsīqī), from Arabic مُوسِيقَى (mūsīqā), ultimately from Ancient Greek μουσική (mousikḗ).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یراق (yaraq). By surface analysis, yara- (“to avail”) + -aq. Cognate with Turkish yarak.
Borrowed from Russian дофи́н (dofín), from French dauphin. Doublet of delfin.
